newsitem.title: USA: OrNda HealthCorp completes United purchase.
newsitem.headline: OrNda HealthCorp completes United purchase.

text.p: OrNda HealthCorp said on Monday it completed the acquisition of substantially all of the assets of United Western Medical Centers, a not-for-profit corporation based in Santa Ana, Calif.

The assets consisted mostly of Western Medical Center, a 288-bed acute care hospital in Santa Ana, Western Medical Center-Anaheim, a 193-bed acute care hospital in Anaheim, Calif., and Western Medical Center-Bartlett, a 202-bed skilled nursing facility in Santa Ana.
OrNda said United Western Medical had about $185 million in annual net revenues in its most recent fiscal year, and it expected the transaction to be accretive to earnings.
Net proceeds would continue the charitable activities of the Western Medical Center Foundation, OrNda said.
